steps.title: Introduction & Setup
steps.description: Learn what UI5 linter is, install it, and set up the demo project you will modernize throughout this tutorial.

steps.title: Running UI5 linter — First Analysis
steps.description: Run the linter for the first time, explore the 53 findings in the legacy demo app, and use the --details flag to understand each issue.

steps.title: Understanding Linter Rules
steps.description: Survey the rule categories, learn which findings can be auto-fixed and which require manual changes, and understand why deprecated patterns matter.

steps.title: Auto-fixing Issues
steps.description: Run ui5lint --fix to apply automatic fixes, inspect what changed with git diff, and learn which issues are blocked until manual fixes are in place.

steps.title: Manual Fixes
steps.description: Migrate the controller to sap.ui.define(), fix global variable access, replace deprecated themes and libraries, update the manifest version, resolve CSP violations, and migrate to the Test Starter concept.

steps.title: Best Practices
steps.description: Integrate UI5 linter into your development workflow and CI/CD pipeline to prevent regressions.

steps.title: Appendix: Legacy Patterns Reference
steps.description: Full reference table of all 53 legacy findings in the demo app, organized by file.
